feature: Stage J native original salvage -> Rust full-stack sale -> real corp wallet
prerequisites: Authorized disposable native EveJS/Code and its GameStore; protect running evejs-data
Original NPC salvage delivered and verified using Stage J warehouse receipt
PR #142 real pending native market sale and Rust settlement patch installed on disposable instance
Authenticated and docked buyer with native character balance
No GitHub Actions or unapproved production wallet mutation

scenarios.name: Real original salvage to corporate revenue
scenarios.expected: One Rust claim and finalized fill, one native item transfer, exactly one player debit and NPC corp gross ISK credit, durable native fill receipt and SOLD journal

scenarios.name: Repeat same buyer and order after reconnect
scenarios.expected: No duplicate item, wallet debit or corp credit; same fillID reconciled

scenarios.name: Two buyers attempt same original salvage
scenarios.expected: Only one canonical Rust claim buyer; loser receives no item and no wallet debit

scenarios.name: Native buyer lacks spendable ISK
scenarios.expected: Rust order remains settling until operator reconciliation; no GameStore stock or wallet mutation, never mint currency

scenarios.name: Source salvage receipt missing or changed
scenarios.expected: Source-specific native GameStore check aborts before wallet changes and leaves Rust order unfinalized

scenarios.name: Duplicate provenance marker after listing
scenarios.expected: No sale, fraud repair required; exactly one original source item demanded

scenarios.name: Forged industry marker or escrow source
scenarios.expected: Reject salvage as manufactured stock; original corp wallet unchanged

scenarios.name: Crash in native transaction after buyer debit but before receipt
scenarios.expected: SQLite rolls back all tables or native poison requires operator intervention; zero partial credits

scenarios.name: Crash after SQLite COMMIT but before Rust finalization
scenarios.expected: Same durable fillID and wallet balances; retry finalizes only Rust, never second debit

scenarios.name: Rust finalize ACK lost
scenarios.expected: GameStore payment remains exactly once; on new attempt Rust claim readback allows journal SOLD seal

scenarios.name: Fake Rust filled state / mismatching fillID
scenarios.expected: Cannot mark SOLD; native financial state remains at NATIVE_SALE_COMMITTED and is reconciled

scenarios.name: Salvage flag OFF but manufacturing ON
scenarios.expected: No salvage Rust claim acquired or wallet/item mutation; industrial settlement unchanged

scenarios.name: Rust salvage operation namespace disabled
scenarios.expected: All salvage pending/claim/finalize/get RPCs reject, manufacturing operations remain valid

scenarios.name: Native market order partially filled
scenarios.expected: Full-stack-only authority rejects partial quantity; no implicit inventory splitting or ISK overpayment

scenarios.name: Real market taxes and broker fees not configured
scenarios.expected: No invented fee or net profit; gross settlement only, production deployment blocked until explicit native fee policy decision

scenarios.name: Two authenticated players validate shared world
scenarios.expected: Real fleet/market/dock presence, inventory refresh for buyer and native NPC source disappearance verified in both clients
